events_Październik 2024.summary:

Astro Paper: Probing Gravity at Large Scales with kSZ-Reconstructed Velocities and

CMB secondaries -- the kinematic Sunyaev-Zeldovich (kSZ) effect and CMB lensing

events_Październik 2024.summary:

populations of galaxy star formation histories (SFH). In the model, individual

temperature for discriminating between various models of inflation and certain
freeze-in dark matter scenarios. It is applied to several classes of
$\alpha$-attractor models as an illustrative example. In the first step, all

events_Październik 2024.title:
Astro Paper: From Shock to Synchrotron: a mini-review on magnetic turbulence in

events_Październik 2024.summary:
Magnetic turbulence plays a crucial role in confining charged particles near
the shock front of Supernova Remnants, enabling them to reach energies up to
hundreds of TeV through a process known as Diffusive Shock Acceleration (DSA).
These high-energy electrons spiral along magnetic field lines, emitting X-ray
synchrotron radiation. The launch of the Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer
(IXPE) has opened a new window into the study of magnetic fields in SNRs
through X-ray polarization measurements.

in the cosmological phenomenology of General Relativity. We pursue this

extraction from rotating black holes - still lacks clear observational

ergosphere as a trigger, causing a plasmoid to separate into an escaping

stacked to improve signal-to-noise and reveal population-level characteristics.
